summary: OpenAI announced that MUFG has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise to about 35,000 employees at Mitsubishi UFJ Bank and is partnering with OpenAI to build AI-driven customer experiences including Moneytree, WealthNavi and a planned digital bank.

categories.reason: The document describes a major bank integrating OpenAI technology into core customer-facing financial products, including robo-advisory and a planned digital bank.
categories.quote: MUFG, including WealthNavi, plans to use OpenAI technology in the digital bank at the center of emutt, its integrated financial services brand.
